description: baseline: LightGBM with 60-trial Optuna TPO search (5-fold CV) — optimal for small tabular binary classification at N=891 with mixed numeric/categorical features

Enhanced feature engineering (ticket group size, title-based age imputation, WomanOrChild flag, cabin number, fare per ticket member) + added CatBoost with native categorical handling, ensembled 50/50 with LightGBM OOF predictions
Added Title-based age imputation, AgeIsNull flag, WomanOrChild and AgeSexMale interaction features, plus 5-seed LightGBM ensemble averaging to reduce prediction variance

Added XGBoost to ensemble (LightGBM leaf-wise vs XGBoost depth-wise creates complementary predictions), plus new features: TicketGroupSize, CabinNum, FarePclassRank, SexClass interaction; blend 5-seed LightGBM + 5-seed XGBoost OOF predictions 50/50

Added TicketGroupSize/IsTicketGroup (same-ticket group proxy), SurnameGroupSize (surname family proxy), CabinNum (numeric cabin ordinal), WCPclass interaction; added max_depth to Optuna HPO; switched ensemble from same-fold-different-model-seed to 5-repeat-5-fold CV (different fold splits per seed for true prediction diversity)
